products.title: Rasasi Hawas Eau De Parfum For Men
products.body_html: Hawas for Him by Rasasi is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for men. Hawas for Him was launched in 2015. Top notes are Apple, Bergamot, Lemon and Cinnamon; middle notes are Watery Notes, Plum, Cardamom and Orange Blossom; base notes are Ambergris, Musk, Patchouli and Driftwood.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Blue Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Turathi Blue is a crisp, fresh, and uplifting scent crafted for the modern man. It starts with a burst of zesty bergamot and mandarin, creating an energizing first impression. The scent then drifts into warm amber, entwined with woody nuances, before finally resting on a base of smooth musk and patchouli with a touch of spice. Ideal for everyday wear, it is both refined and approachable with a touch of Middle Eastern richness.

products.title: Lattafa Najdia Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Najdia Eau De Parfum is a fresh and bright unisex scent that mixes citrus, light spices, soft woods and clean watery notes. It opens with a sharp hit of lemon, bergamot, cinnamon, apple and lemongrass that gives an instant fresh-spicy feeling. Then the heart brings refreshing watery notes, lavender, rosemary and cardamom that make the scent clean, cool and smooth. Finally, the base gets all warm and cozy with musk, amber, sandalwood, cedar and a slight touch of tobacco which adds a gentle depth to the perfume without making it too heavy.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Men Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Pour Homme Eau De Parfum is a fresh and clean fragrance for men. It makes one experience of a cool ocean breeze on a hot, sunny day. It was launched in 2017. The Eau De Parfum begins with a sweet burst of grapefruit scent along with mandarin orange. The heart tones are surrounded by the warm musk  and amberwood smell. The soft and confident smell makes you effortlessly attractive on any day.

products.title: Afnan 9AM Dive Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9AM Dive Eau de Parfum is a fresh aquatic fragrance for both men and women that was Launched in 2022 it brings a cooling and energising feel that is perfect for warm days. The perfume starts with bright lemon, mint, black currant and pink pepper (top notes). In the middle, it turns smooth with apple, cedar and incense. The base carries ginger, sandalwood, patchouli and jasmine creating a balanced, refreshing yet slightly woody scent.

products.title: Versace Dylan Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Dylan Blue Eau de Toilette is a fresh and strong men’s fragrance that feels clean, modern, and confident. It opens with a cool splash of bergamot, grapefruit, and watery notes that feel very fresh on skin. Slowly, it moves into a spicy and slightly woody heart with black pepper and ambroxan. The base feels warm and smooth with musk, incense, and tonka bean. This scent feels masculine, stylish, and perfect for daily wear.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Fire Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Fire Eau de Parfum is a fresh and modern unisex fragrance from Rasasi. Launched in 2025, it is an aromatic aquatic scent that combines natural green and floral tones with warm and deep base notes. The fragrance's opening is very relaxed with fresh Clary Sage, then Egyptian Jasmine and Marine notes blossom in the middle and finally, Amber, Mineral notes and Ambergris compose a warm base.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum is a classy, warm, and spicy fragrance designed for men who love to stand out. This perfume brings together rich woody notes, fresh spices, and smooth amber to create a bold yet inviting scent.

Launched in 2023, Afnan Turathi Brown smells modern but carries a timeless touch. With every spray, you get a burst of fresh spices, warm amber, and smooth vanilla that lasts all day. It’s perfect for men who want to feel confident and elegant, whether it’s for daily wear or special evenings.

If you enjoy strong, warm perfumes that leave a lasting impression wherever you go, Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum is worth trying.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Profumo Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Profumo EDP for men is a deep smoky take on the fresh classic, opens with cool sea notes and sharp bergamot, heart brings rosemary sage geranium, base hits with incense and patchouli. Crafted by Alberto Morillas back in 2015. Fragrance fans rave about it as the grown-up version, richer, darker with that churchy incense twist, great projection sillage that turns heads.

products.title: Issey Miyake L'eau D'issey Pour Homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Issey Miyake L’Eau D’Issey Pour Homme is a fresh, clean, and uplifting perfume for men with a gentle woody touch. It opens with bright citrus notes like yuzu, lemon, mandarin and bergamot that feel very crisp and refreshing. The middle brings a combination of spicy nutmeg, saffron, cinnamon and soft florals like blue lotus and lily-of-the-valley that give a smooth balance. As it dries down, it turns warm, woody and a bit musky with vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, amber and a soft tobacco note. It is a timeless, everyday fragrance that feels light, natural and very easy to wear.

products.title: Rayhaan Ocean Rush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Ocean Rush Eau de Parfum is a fresh, aquatic style scent for men who like clean, energetic fragrances. Launched in 2024, it opens with a splash of watery, citrus notes like cascalone, bergamot, aquozone and mandarin that feel bright and breezy. The heart features herbal notes of lavender, cypress and rosemary, giving it a green aromatic feel. The dry down settles into warm amber, musk and patchouli, giving smooth, masculine depth.

products.title: Paco Rabanne Invictus Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne Invictus Parfum is an invigorating, sleek, and masculine perfume that radiates modernity and self-assurance. The scent starts off with a combination of icy oceanic notes, lavender and pink pepper, producing a fresh and subtly spicy introduction. The heart is very clean and has a soapy aspect due to the gentle green notes, whereas the base gets cosy and silky with the blend of musk, cashmere, and sandalwood. The fragrance is, in a way, athletic, powerful, and suited for day-to-day use.

products.title: French Avenue Spectre Wraith Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Spectre Wraith Eau de Parfum is a dark, bold and smooth woody aquatic fragrance made for men who like strong, modern scents. It opens with a rich and boozy feel and slowly turns warm, earthy and slightly sweet on the skin. The mix of rum, spices, coffee, woods and sugar cane gives this perfume a deep and addictive smell. French Avenue Spectre Wraith Eau de Parfum stays balanced, strong but not too loud and feels premium from start to end.

products.title: Nautica Voyage N 83 Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Nautica Voyage N-83 Eau de Toilette is a fresh aquatic scent for men from the house of Nautica. It is inspired by ocean breezes and cool sea air, giving a clean sporty vibe. The scent opens with fresh sea notes, peppermint and petitgrain, moves into a soft, spicy heart of lavender, cardamom and nutmeg and settles into a smooth base of musk, cedar and sandalwood. The blend feels fresh, slightly spicy and woody at the same time, making it a very easy everyday men’s perfume for those who like clean marine scents.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Pour Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Pour Homme Eau De Parfum for men is a fresh powerful scent perfect for warm days, it starts with cool sea notes and zesty green mandarin, then moves to herbal clary sage lavender and geranium in the heart, finishes with smooth mineral vetiver and patchouli base. Made by Alberto Morillas in 2022. Folks in fragrance circles love it as a modern upgrade to the classic, super clean aquatic vibe with solid staying power and nice reach that feels just right.

products.title: French Avenue Essence de Blanc Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Essence de Blanc Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and airy unisex fragrance made for daily wear. It was launched in 2022 and opens with bright citrus and green notes that feel light and refreshing from the first spray. As it settles, soft, spicy and minty tones come forward, giving a calm and cooling feel. The base is smooth and slightly aquatic with ambergris and soft floral notes, making the scent feel modern, new and easy to wear.

products.title: Versace Man Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Man Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette is a men's fragrance that is fresh and clean, light, cool, and classy at the same time. Citrus freshness that is very sharp and refreshing is the first thing that you notice when you spray it. After some time, a little bit of soft spicy and herbal notes get revealed and create a very nice balancing act. In the end, a gentle touch of woody and musky notes is almost imperceptibly close to the skin but still exudes a calm and masculine aura. This fragrance is an excellent choice for everyday use, for the office, and in hot climates.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Man Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Man Eau de Parfum is a fresh and bold men’s fragrance from the house of Swiss Arabian. It opens with a clean mix of citrus and lavender that feels fresh and energetic from the first spray. As it settles, you can feel the spiciness and the marine notes, which contribute to the fragrance a little depth and a pleasant oceanic feel. The warm, sweet and woody base is formed by the blending of amber, patchouli, and creamy praline notes.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Eau de Toilette is a male perfume that was introduced in 1996. It is produced using fresh citrus tones, sea tones and gentle woody tones that are very clean and natural. The introductory is bright, fresh and very gradually becomes liquid and smooth. During the dry down, it is hot and dry. This perfume is light, clean and comfortable to use; it suits everyday and hot seasons.

products.title: Kenzo Homme Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Kenzo Homme Eau de Toilette is a French fragrance brand in the form of a Woody Aquatic men's fragrance. In 2022, Kenzo Homme Eau de Toilette was released. The top notes include Sea Notes, Calypsone and Nutmeg, middle notes include Pine and Patchouli, and the base notes include Sandalwood and Cedar.

products.title: Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html:
Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme Eau De Toilette is a fresh, masculine fragrance inspired by the deep blue sea and the energy of ocean waves. It’s a scent that feels clean, refreshing, and full of life, perfect for men who want to smell crisp and confident all day.

The fragrance opens with a burst of juicy mandarin and orange, blended with the green freshness of petitgrain. At the heart, unique marine notes of seaweed meet soft lavender and cotton flower, giving it a cool yet sophisticated vibe. The base brings warmth and depth with Virginia cedar, patchouli, clary sage, and amber, making it long-lasting and memorable.

Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme is like stepping out of the ocean on a sunny day, fresh, cool, and effortlessly stylish. It’s perfect for men who want a clean signature scent for daily wear.

products.title: Men Daytime Discovery Set - Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Absolu, Dior Sauvage, Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir
products.body_html:
Start your day with confidence and style with our Men Daytime Discovery Set, featuring three vibrant fragrances:

  • Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Absolu EDP: Dive into the refreshing aquatic and woody notes that blend seamlessly to create a modern and dynamic scent.
  • Dior Sauvage EDP: Experience the raw freshness of bergamot combined with the powerful woody trail, perfect for a bold and adventurous day.
  • Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir EDP: Enjoy the sharp, spicy, and woody notes that deliver a sleek and elegant fragrance, ideal for daytime sophistication.

Curated for the modern man, these fragrances are perfect for enhancing your daytime presence.

products.title: Neesh Glazed Water Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Glazed Water Extrait De Parfum is a fresh, clean and modern aquatic scent made for men who like a cool and classy smell. It starts with bright marine and citrus notes that are like a gentle sea breeze on the skin, turning spicy and soft gradually and finally, warm woody notes dominate the dry down. Due to the extrait concentration, the perfume feels light, refreshing and yet strong.

products.title: Orto Parisi Megamare Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Orto Parisi Megamare Extrait De Parfum is an invigorating and oceanic fragrance. Its top notes consist of a sparkling bergamot and lemon that are bright, clean, and lively, and then the heart of the scent takes you to the beach with seaweed, calone, and hedione that have a watery, marine quality. Musk, ambroxan, and cedar form the base of the perfume that is gentle, velvety, and durable. This fragrance gives the impression of being refreshing, contemporary, and suitable for lovers of water and fresh air scents from nature.

products.title: Abdul Samad Al Qurashi Safari Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Abdul Samad Al Qurashi Safari Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh and modern unisex fragrance from Abdul Samad Al Qurashi. Launched in 2024, this scent feels clean, airy and refreshing from the first spray. Abdul Samad Al Qurashi Safari Blue Eau de Parfum opens with bright citrus and spice, then moves into a calm lavender heart and finally settles into a soft, earthy base.
